title: Japanese Language — N4 to N3 Vocabulary and Kanji
description: Bridges the gap between JLPT N4 and N3 by building the vocabulary, kanji, and reading skills the grammar-focused JAPN-101 left open. Students expand from ~300 to ~650 kanji using a radical-mnemonic approach, grow their vocabulary from ~1,500 to ~3,750 words through thematic grouping and spaced repetition, master the on'yomi/kun'yomi prediction system to decode compound words, work through the near-synonym pairs (見る/見える, 訪ねる/尋ねる, 理由/原因) that trip up intermediate learners, and develop the skim-scan-dive reading strategy required to handle authentic N3 texts under JLPT time constraints.
learning_outcomes: Recognize and read approximately 370 new N3 kanji in compound and standalone contexts
Apply the four on'yomi/kun'yomi prediction rules to decode unknown compound words
Use radicals as mnemonic anchors to learn and distinguish visually similar kanji
Demonstrate vocabulary knowledge of approximately 2,000 new N3 words across 18 thematic categories
Discriminate between near-synonym pairs — volitional vs. non-volitional verbs, transitive vs. intransitive pairs, register variants — choosing the correct word and particle for the context
Read and comprehend N3-level authentic texts (NHK Web Easy, informational notices, short essays) using the skim-scan-dive strategy within a 3-minute-per-passage time constraint
Identify discourse connectives in reading passages and use them to trace the logical structure of an argument
